create_mock_worker: create a new MockWorker instance using the static new method with a worker_id and MephistoDB
bonus_mock_worker: bonus a MockWorker by amount and reason using the bonus_worker method
block_mock_worker: block a MockWorker for a specified reason using the block_worker method
unblock_mock_worker: unblock a previously blocked MockWorker using the unblock_worker method with a reason
check_mock_worker_blocked: check if a MockWorker is blocked using the is_blocked method with a requester
